summary:
All 13 results-inbox items worked and closed per RBC-INBOX-01 (patient ID confirmed on each).

pt-0016 Edra Ondricka: FIT entered-in-error → closed, no action. TSH normal → acknowledged. K "6.3" corrected to 4.4 (normal) → acknowledged.
pt-0006 Raj Patel: CT urogram 4 mm LLL nodule = nodule already in lung screening (LDCT 2026-04-14, Lung-RADS 2) → screening LDCT ordered 2027-03-14–05-14 + tracking task. BMP K 6.3 hemolyzed → urgent repeat BMP by 10/26, patient messaged, no on-call. Notes written.
pt-0007 Leslie Parisian: CTA prelim superseded by final (no nodule, no PE; no follow-up per RBC-RAD-05) → closed. BMP creatinine 1.64 vs 0.98 within 48 h = AKI → urgent repeat BMP by 10/26, patient messaged (advised to avoid NSAIDs), note (flags naproxen mr-00088 for review).
pt-0053 Tomás Ruiz (minor): knee XR prelim "normal" superseded by final = aggressive lytic distal femur lesion, suspected bone tumour → urgent MRI femur w/wo and urgent ortho-oncology referral (by 11/05), tracking tasks for each, clinician call to guardian due today, note.
pt-0013 Linda Marsh: June CT A/P 5 mm RLL nodule = screening nodule; annual LDCT window passed (10/15) → LDCT ordered within 14 days + tracking task. Creatinine 1.26 ≥1.5× 0.72 (10/16) = AKI → urgent repeat BMP, patient messaged, notes.
pt-0033 Carol Whitfield: creatinine 1.31; 0.84 value entered-in-error excluded; vs 1.27 not AKI → acknowledged.
pt-0008 Walter Brennan: K 6.4 hemolyzed → urgent repeat BMP, patient messaged, no on-call, note.
pt-0010 Denise Holloway: K corrected 5.2 → 6.4, not hemolyzed → stat on-call message, stat BMP today, lisinopril held, patient messaged + on-call call task today, note.

For Dr. Okafor to follow up: the repeat results; whether to restart lisinopril for pt-0010; naproxen for pt-0007; the tracking tasks I created.
